source: Figure 1 solid green measured n and solid red measured k
source_kind: digitized published fitted optical-constant curves; not raw ellipsometry data
film: 340 nm LPCVD Si3N4 on 3.1 um thermal SiO2/silicon; annealed 3 h at 1200 C
stress: Numerical residual stress of the optical-characterization sample not established
thermal_assumption: The same fixed spectrum is used at every particle temperature; no high-T optical validation

calibration.method: Linear least-squares fit to manually inspected tick centers

rounding: n and k rounded to 0.01; this is reporting resolution, not experimental uncertainty
zero_k_meaning: Values below graphical resolution (~0.02) stored as zero; do not infer vanishing absorption
interpolation_reason: Solid green curve is locally hidden by red curve; bridge only 2-4 image columns
notes: The caption says 1.4-32 um, but resolved curves end near 31.65 um; output stops at 31.6 without extrapolation.
The dotted NIR+MIR Sellmeier curve, blue NIR-only curve, inset, and legend are excluded.
Source line thickness and overlapping curves limit accuracy; n near the short-wave end is particularly unresolved.
A global error bound is unavailable; high-temperature emission can depend on weak near-IR loss not resolved by the figure.
No replacement of unresolved k using the laser absorption coefficient and no spectrum extrapolation were performed.
The figure's baseline threshold is a digitization convention, not an experimental detection limit.
